# Contributing

* `make test` must pass under `-std=c++23 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic` before a PR.
* Schema changes: bump `version`, add `sinceVersion` on new fields, update `schema/CHANGELOG.md`,
  and freeze the previous version under `schema/versions/`. `make check` enforces compatibility.
* Never edit anything under `gen/`; it is regenerated by the build.
* No allocation on a hot path after initialisation; no wall clock in an engine (use the injected `Clock`).
* Every engine must have a replay-determinism test: same journal in, same state hash out.
